# Course Materials Index

This page provides easy access to all lecture materials for the FGCZ Protein Bioinformatics Course (P3003).

## Current Lectures (2024/2025)

These are the lectures currently being used in the course:

- [PTM Analysis](PTM_Analysis.html) - Phosphoproteomics: DPA vs DPU analysis
- [Experimental Design (Short)](ExpDesignShort.html) - Condensed experimental design principles
- [FASTA & Protein Inference](FASTA_ProteinInference.html) - Protein database and inference concepts
- [Multiplicity (Simple)](Multiplicity_Simple.html) - Simplified multiple testing correction
- [ORA & GSEA Slides](GSEA_Slides.html) - Over-Representation Analysis and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis

## Archive

These lectures are available but not actively used in the current course:

### Experimental Design
- [Experimental Design (Full)](ExpDesign.html) - Complete experimental design principles

### Statistical Foundations
- [Hypothesis Testing](Hypothesis_Testing_p3003.html) - Statistical hypothesis testing concepts
- [Introduction to Linear Models](IntroductionToLinearModels.html) - Linear modeling fundamentals
- [Multiplicity (Full)](Multiplicity_p3003.html) - Handling multiple comparisons
- [Sample Size Estimation](SampleSizeEstimation.html) - Power analysis and sample size calculations

### Additional Resources
- [Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)](GSEA_with_msig.html) - Pathway and functional enrichment analysis
- [Brief Introduction to R](BriefIntroductionTooR.html) - R programming basics
